reading_note: The arc traces the operative power of divine truth (Living Spirit) constructing the ordered heavens out of the primal commixture of good with self-love. After the firstfruits of the five degrees of reception are received and the mother-matrix of life is joined to the operative power, the falsifying loves are bound and held in tension; their qualities pour out and are separated. The Living Spirit then works as an architect raising heaven by heaven, opening the ten fixed boundaries of state, and as a craftsman melting and recasting raw natural good into formed vessels — discrete receptacles of truth, each fitted to its use. The whole construction is preparation: the palace built so that when the call of the Third Messenger comes, the good in every form is taken up to the celestial region while falsity from evil with its darkness is cast down to the hells.
